visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a red paper envelope against a desk background featuring a colorful mechanical keyboard and various small figurines. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) A young woman with short brown hair and a purple fuzzy jacket is seated in an office environment, holding a brown Shiba Inu plush doll. She looks directly at the lens while speaking, displaying expressive facial movements. (3) The frame transitions to a screen recording of a web browser on a monitor. The cursor moves to a Google search bar, types in Chinese text, and navigates through a government website. (4) The screen recording displays a Google Map of Taiwan covered in numerous red pin markers. The camera zooms in to show high density in urban areas. (5) The woman stands in a bright indoor hallway next to a silver ATM machine. She holds a stack of 1000 TWD banknotes and a red envelope. (6) A close-up shows the woman fanning the banknotes, revealing that the reverse side of the bills is blank white paper. (7) The woman leans very close to the camera, laughing with an open mouth and squinted eyes. A large QR code and informative text overlays appear over her face. She playfuly pushes the camera lens with her hand as the scene ends.

(6) [Subtitle]: 點選第一個央行的網站. (7) [Subtitle]: 再點擊新聞稿裡的Google地圖. (8) [Subtitle]: 上面就會顯示全部有提供換钞服務的銀行. (9) [Subtitle]: 而且他們大部分也會有新鈔ATM可以用喔. (10) [Subtitle]: 這樣就不用特別跑去台銀. (11) [Subtitle]: 去附近的ATM就可以換啦.
